title: Webflow
content:
# Webflow

Connect a Webflow site, then create, publish, update and delete the posts in its CMS blog collections through the Blogs API.

Connect a Webflow site and manage the posts in its CMS collections with the [Blogs API](/blogs/list-blogs).

A connected account uses `platform: "webflow"` and represents one site; each CMS collection with a rich text field is a blog.

## Quick reference

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Platform value | `webflow` |
| What it manages | Items in the site's CMS collections that have a rich text field (blog id = collection id) |
| Auth | Zernio Webflow app (OAuth), or a site API token (Sites read, CMS read and write) |
| Social posting | No |
| Analytics | No |
| Scheduling | No (Webflow's API cannot schedule) |
| Drafts | Yes (`isPublished: false`) |
| Article body | HTML (`bodyHtml`) in the collection's rich text field |
| Tracking pixels | Yes, with the Zernio Webflow app ([Tracking pixels](/platforms/webflow/tracking-pixels)) |

## Before you start

You need a Webflow site with a CMS plan and a blog collection, and the right to create API tokens for it. To publish articles, the site must have been published at least once.

## Connect

Call `GET /v1/connect/webflow` and send the user to the returned `authUrl`, or create a site API token and call `POST /v1/connect/webflow/token`. See [Connect](/platforms/webflow/connect).
